status: refused; mechanical deliverables complete; visual self-check fails binding terrain constraints

generation.mode: single built-in ImageGen whole-canvas edit with edit target and canon attached

lightingIsotropy.metric: 36-bin land-luminance-gradient magnitude peak divided by uniform-bin mean; delivered water-mask pixels and gradients below 12 luminance units excluded
lightingIsotropy.visualCheck: No coherent cast-shadow field or whole-cell sun direction is visible, but basalt tops and conifer branch tiers remain lighter than adjacent vertical or lower faces. The aggregate metric does not override the literal equal-value rule.

buildableVsSteepFraction.basis: manual estimated fraction of non-water land area at native source resolution
buildableVsSteepFraction.method: The pale northern ground, western glades, viaduct shoulders, and fallen-tree clearing count as buildable; exposed gorge faces count as steep; dense forest, talus, and broken mossy rock make up the remainder.

crown.method: Full-frame native-resolution dark-conifer connected-component census of all 38 distinct crown components found, including saplings and edge crowns; median source width 25.5 px scaled by 2560/1254 and converted at 0.048 m per final pixel.

waterMask.encoding: opaque white water pixels on fully transparent non-water pixels; binary alpha
waterMask.componentNote: The west-edge beck is visually detached from the two gorge-stream reaches; the gorge reaches are separated by the required dry rune slot.
waterMask.method: Native-resolution manual trace of every visible beck, pool, fall, wash, and gorge-stream surface, with a dry gap at the rune slot; enclosed holes were filled and the result inspected as a magenta overlay.

refusalReasons: The literal neutral-lighting rule fails by eye: basalt top planes and many crown branch tiers remain lighter than adjacent sides even though there is no coherent cast-shadow field.
Conifer crowns contain internal light-dark branch modelling rather than one flat value from tip to skirt.
The rune-chain cut reads as a raised stone-lined kerb or wall across much of the cell, and it appears to span the gorge instead of stopping at one lip and resuming on the far lip.
The west-edge beck remains visibly detached under the canopy before the main gorge stream, so the hydrology is not demonstrably continuous.
The requested grey-blue haze is too weak to soften every crown edge.
openRisks: The dense east-side canopy reaches the edge through several broad runs and may reproduce the dark square seam the owner rejected.
The facing gorge shoulders exist as exposed rock, but their usable level area and separation are not mechanically established from this raster.
The water mask is mechanically binary, same-size, and hole-free, but exact wet-edge placement remains a human visual gate.
verificationLimits: No content retry was made because the first result was square and the packet permits a retry only for a non-square output.
No stitch, bake, mount, public asset, art-source asset, or runtime command was run.
